title: One Evaluation Is Enough: Inversion-Free Image Editing with Trajectory Correction
abstract: arXiv:2610.30827v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-image editing commonly relies on inversion and iterative sampling, while efficient one-step editors often stabilize a large update by estimating and averaging editing fields at multiple noise levels. We ask a stricter question: is a single temporal field evaluation sufficient for reliable inversion-free editing? Our answer rests on a previously underused duality in a variance-preserving (VP) one-step model: one source-target query at a shared noisy state simultaneously determines a local angular semantic tangent and a clean endpoint displacement. We integrate the tangent over the analytically known remaining VP angle to obtain a nominal one-step transport, and use the endpoint displacement to correct its long-horizon extrapolation through a constrained projection. This transport-first, correction-second construction yields Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT), a closed-form, training-free editor requiring only one noise lev

translated_title: 一次评估足矣：基于轨迹校正的无反演图像编辑
translated_abstract: 真实图像编辑通常依赖于反演和迭代采样，而高效的单步编辑器往往通过在多个噪声水平下估计并平均编辑场来稳定大幅度的更新。我们提出一个更严格的问题：单次时间场评估是否足以实现可靠的无反演编辑？我们的答案基于方差保持（VP）单步模型中一个此前未被充分利用的对偶性：在共享噪声状态下进行一次源-目标查询，可同时确定局部角向语义切线和干净的端点位移。我们将切线沿解析已知的剩余VP角度进行积分，得到名义上的单步传输，并利用端点位移通过受约束投影来校正其长程外推。这种“先传输、后校正”的构造产生了端点校准传输（ECT），这是一种闭式、免训练的编辑器，且仅需一个噪声水平的评估。
tldr: 提出端点校准传输（ECT），一种免训练、闭式求解的无反演图像编辑方法，仅需单次场评估即可通过“先传输、后校正”的构造实现可靠的图像编辑。
en_tdlr: ECT is a closed-form, training-free, inversion-free image editor that achieves reliable editing with only a single field evaluation through a transport-first, correction-second construction.
